artwork.title: The Starry Night
artwork.subtitle: De sterrennacht
artwork.description: Painted during Van Gogh's stay at the Saint-Paul-de-Mausole asylum in Saint-Rémy, this work depicts a dreamlike view from his window before sunrise.

artist.biography: Vincent van Gogh was a Dutch Post-Impressionist painter whose expressive brushwork and vibrant colors transformed modern art.

exhibition.title: Van Gogh
exhibition.subtitle: Light and Color
exhibition.description: This exhibition presents a selection of works that highlight the evolution of Vincent van Gogh's artistic language.
